<instructions>
Build a timezone overlap checker web app using a popular web framework of your choice. Do NOT use vanilla JS or a raw Node.js `http` server. The app must run with a single command (`npm run dev` or equivalent).

You have **full creative freedom** on everything: technology choices, code architecture, file structure, component separation, state management, styling approach, design system, and UX. Own every decision — make it clean, well-structured, and something you're proud of.
</instructions>

<purpose>
A tool for remote workers, distributed teams, and digital nomads who need to find common meeting windows or compare their schedule against colleagues in other timezones.
</purpose>

<modes>
The app has two modes the user can toggle between:

**Meeting Mode** (default)
Find hours when everyone across all selected cities is simultaneously awake. All cities share the same highlighted overlap window. Think: scheduling a group call where every participant must be available.

**Base Mode**
One city is the "base" (the reference). Each other city gets its own independent overlap calculated only against the base. Different cities may highlight different hours. Think: a person living in one city who works with people in several other cities and wants to see per-person availability.
</modes>

<cities>
- Users maintain a list of cities to compare. Default: San Francisco, Denpasar, Geneva.
- Cities come from a predefined catalog of ~34 cities spanning all major world regions (North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Middle East, Asia, Oceania).
- Users add cities via a searchable dropdown (search by city name or country). Remove any city from the list. No duplicates allowed.
- No custom/arbitrary timezone entries — only the predefined catalog.
</cities>

<reference-city>
- The first city in the list is always the **reference city**, visually marked (e.g. a "REF" badge).
- All hour calculations are anchored to the reference city's timezone.
- Users can click any city's name to promote it as the new reference (it moves to the top).
- In Base Mode, overlap is computed between the reference city and each other city independently.
</reference-city>

<availability>
Users configure their personal "awake window" via a settings panel:

- **Wake-up hour** (0–23, default: 7)
- **Sleep hour** (0–23, default: 23)
- **Time format**: 12h or 24h (default: 12h)

The awake window applies uniformly to all cities (everyone shares the same sleep schedule). Overnight ranges are supported (e.g. wake at 22, sleep at 6 for night-shift workers). Changes take effect immediately.
</availability>

<grid>
The core visualization is a **24-column grid** (one column per hour of the reference city's day, 0–23).

Each cell shows what hour it is **locally** in that city when it's that column's hour in the reference city.

Three visual states per cell:
1. **Sleeping** — the local hour falls outside the awake window → faded/muted
2. **Awake, no overlap** — awake but not part of the overlap → neutral
3. **Overlap** — awake AND this hour qualifies as overlap → highlighted (e.g. green), bold text
</grid>

<overlap-summary>
Displayed above the grid when 2+ cities are present:

- **Meeting Mode**: total overlap hours count + time range(s) in the reference city's timezone. Zero overlap → warning message.
- **Base Mode**: one line per non-reference city, each with its own overlap count + time range(s). Zero overlap → individual warning.

Time ranges are inclusive start → exclusive end (e.g. "9am — 12pm" = hours 9, 10, 11). Non-contiguous windows are shown as separate badges/ranges.
</overlap-summary>

<timezone-math>
- UTC offsets derived from the current date → DST is automatically handled.
- Fractional offsets supported (e.g. India UTC+5:30, Nepal UTC+5:45).
- Each city displays its current UTC offset.
</timezone-math>

<responsive>
**Desktop (≥768px)**: cities as rows, hours as columns (horizontal grid). Left: city info + REF badge + UTC offset. Center: 24 hour cells. Right: remove button.

**Mobile (<768px)**: cities as columns, hours as rows (vertical layout). These are **two separate layouts**, not a single responsive grid.
</responsive>

<persistence>
All state (city list, settings, active mode) is persisted to localStorage. Refreshing restores the last configuration. A new browser/incognito session starts with defaults.
</persistence>

<defaults>
On first visit:
- 3 cities: San Francisco, Denpasar, Geneva
- Meeting mode active
- Awake window: 7am–11pm
- 12-hour format
- Overlap summary showing common availability across the 3 default cities
- A hint at the bottom: "Green cells = everyone awake"
</defaults>

<important>
- `<title>` and page heading must be your model name (e.g. "Claude Sonnet 4.5" or "GPT-4o")
- The grid must make overlaps **instantly obvious** — alignment is critical
- Full creative freedom on colors, typography, and visual style — design the best possible UI/UX
- Polished, production-quality — not a prototype
</important>

Work only inside the current working directory. Do not edit files outside the current working directory.
During setup, configure your app and package scripts to use port 9324, then use that port for runtime verification.
Use pnpm exclusively if dependency installation or package scripts are needed. Do not use npm.
Set the browser title and the primary visible title to your model name, using only identity information already available to you. Add nothing else to either title.
Run the relevant checks yourself. Do not edit files outside the current working directory.

# A dev server may bind IPv4, IPv6, or both; a run is only unreachable when no

probe() {

    curl -fsS --max-time 5 "http://[::1]:$port$path" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

**Clarifying Functional Modes**

I'm refining the operational modes, differentiating between "Meeting Mode" for universal overlap and "Base Mode" for pairwise comparisons against a reference city. This distinction will drive distinct display logic and output summaries for each.

**Selecting Key Cities**

I'm currently curating a comprehensive catalog of 34 cities across all major global regions, ensuring diverse timezone representation. My focus is on establishing default cities for new users and implementing a robust search and removal mechanism for city selection.

**Visualizing Timezones**

I'm detailing the grid visualization, where each column represents an hour anchored to the reference city. I'm also defining how users can easily switch the reference city and how "Base Mode" will calculate overlaps independently between the reference and other cities, with a visual "REF" badge for clarity.

**Visualizing Overlap States**

I'm now detailing the cell states within the grid visualization. This includes designing the visual cues for "Sleeping," "Awake, no overlap," and "Overlap" states, ensuring they are distinct and intuitive. I'm also focused on precise alignment for instant overlap recognition and a current time indicator.

**Calculating Overlap Details**

I'm now refining how overlap is presented, specifying the output for both "Meeting Mode" and "Base Mode." **Implementing Data Persistence**

I'm planning to use `localStorage` to save user selections, specifically the array of selected `cityIds`. This will ensure that their chosen cities are retained between sessions, enhancing user experience.

**Setting Default Parameters**

+export const MINUTES_PER_DAY = 24 * 60
+
+const formatterCache = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>()
+
+function getFormatter(timeZone: string): Intl.DateTimeFormat {
+  let formatter = formatterCache.get(timeZone)
+  if (!formatter) {
+    formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
+      timeZone,
+      hourCycle: 'h23',
+      year: 'numeric',
+      month: 'numeric',
+      day: 'numeric',
+      hour: 'numeric',
+      minute: 'numeric',
+      second: 'numeric',
+    })
+    formatterCache.set(timeZone, formatter)
+  }
+  return formatter
+}
+
+/**
+ * UTC offset of `timeZone` at the given instant, in minutes (east-positive).
+ * Derived dynamically from Intl so DST is automatically handled by the runtime engine.
+ */
+export function getUtcOffsetMinutes(timeZone: string, at: Date = new Date()): number {
+  try {
+    const parts = getFormatter(timeZone).formatToParts(at)
+    const read = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) =>
+      Number(parts.find((part) => part.type === type)?.value ?? 0)
+
+    const asUtc = Date.UTC(
+      read('year'),
+      read('month') - 1,
+      read('day'),
+      read('hour') % 24,
+      read('minute'),
+      read('second')
+    )
+    const instant = Math.floor(at.getTime() / 1000) * 1000
+    return Math.round((asUtc - instant) / 60_000)
+  } catch {
+    return 0
+  }
+}
+
+/** Format offset: e.g. "UTC+5:30", "UTC-7", "UTC±0" */
+export function formatUtcOffset(offsetMinutes: number): string {
+  if (offsetMinutes === 0) return 'UTC±0'
+  const sign = offsetMinutes > 0 ? '+' : '-'
+  const abs = Math.abs(offsetMinutes)
+  const hours = Math.floor(abs / 60)
+  const minutes = abs % 60
+  return `UTC${sign}${hours}${minutes ? `:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}` : ''}`
+}
+
+/** Wrap a minute-of-day value into [0, 1440). */
+export function wrapMinutes(minutes: number): number {
+  return ((minutes % MINUTES_PER_DAY) + MINUTES_PER_DAY) % MINUTES_PER_DAY
+}
+
+/**
+ * Local minute-of-day in a city when it is `referenceHour` o'clock in the
+ * reference city.
+ */
+export function localMinuteOfDay(
+  referenceHour: number,
+  referenceOffset: number,
+  cityOffset: number
+): number {
+  return wrapMinutes(referenceHour * 60 + (cityOffset - referenceOffset))
+}
+
+export type TimeFormat = '12h' | '24h'
+
+/** Format hour for column headers or settings, e.g. "7am" or "07:00" */
+export function formatWholeHour(hour: number, format: TimeFormat): string {
+  const h = ((hour % 24) + 24) % 24
+  if (format === '24h') {
+    return `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00`
+  }
+  const suffix = h < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'
+  const hour12 = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12
+  return `${hour12}${suffix}`
+}
+
+/** Compact label for grid cells, e.g. "9a", "12p", "9:30a" or "09", "12", "09:30" */
+export function formatCellHour(minuteOfDay: number, format: TimeFormat): string {
+  const wrapped = wrapMinutes(minuteOfDay)
+  const hour = Math.floor(wrapped / 60)
+  const minutes = wrapped % 60
+  const mm = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')
+
+  if (format === '24h') {
+    if (minutes !== 0) {
+      return `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${mm}`
+    }
+    return String(hour).padStart(2, '0')
+  }
+
+  const suffix = hour < 12 ? 'a' : 'p'
+  const hour12 = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12
+  if (minutes !== 0) {
+    return `${hour12}:${mm}${suffix}`
+  }
+  return `${hour12}${suffix}`
+}
+
+/** Full time string for tooltip or detail, e.g. "9:30 AM" or "09:30" */
+export function formatFullTime(minuteOfDay: number, format: TimeFormat): string {
+  const wrapped = wrapMinutes(minuteOfDay)
+  const hour = Math.floor(wrapped / 60)
+  const minutes = wrapped % 60
+  const mm = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')
+
+  if (format === '24h') {
+    return `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${mm}`
+  }
+
+  const suffix = hour < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'
+  const hour12 = hour % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour % 12
+  return `${hour12}:${mm} ${suffix}`
+}
+
+/** Get the current whole hour in reference city */
+export function currentHourAtOffset(offsetMinutes: number, at: Date = new Date()): number {
+  const utcMinutes = at.getUTCHours() * 60 + at.getUTCMinutes()
+  const localMinutes = wrapMinutes(utcMinutes + offsetMinutes)
+  return Math.floor(localMinutes / 60)
+}

+import type { City } from '@/data/cities'
+import {
+  currentHourAtOffset,
+  formatWholeHour,
+  getUtcOffsetMinutes,
+  localMinuteOfDay,
+  type TimeFormat,
+} from './timezone'
+
+export type Mode = 'meeting' | 'base'
+
+export interface AwakeWindow {
+  /** Hour (0–23) the awake window starts, inclusive. Default: 7 */
+  wakeHour: number
+  /** Hour (0–23) the awake window ends, exclusive. Default: 23 */
+  sleepHour: number
+}
+
+export type CellState = 'sleeping' | 'awake' | 'overlap'
+
+export interface HourCell {
+  /** Hour of reference city (0–23) */
+  referenceHour: number
+  /** Local minute of day in this city at referenceHour */
+  localMinute: number
+  /** Visual state */
+  state: CellState
+  /** Is awake */
+  isAwake: boolean
+}
+
+export interface CityRow {
+  city: City
+  offsetMinutes: number
+  isReference: boolean
+  cells: HourCell[]
+}
+
+export interface HourRange {
+  /** Inclusive start hour in reference time (0–23) */
+  start: number
+  /** Exclusive end hour in reference time (1–24, or >24 if wrapped midnight) */
+  end: number
+}
+
+export interface OverlapResult {
+  hours: number[]
+  ranges: HourRange[]
+}
+
+export interface Schedule {
+  rows: CityRow[]
+  referenceOffset: number
+  currentReferenceHour: number | null
+  meeting: OverlapResult
+  perCity: Map<string, OverlapResult>
+}
+
+export const HOURS = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => i)
+
+/**
+ * Checks if a local minute of day is within the awake window.
+ * Supports overnight ranges (e.g. wake at 22, sleep at 6).
+ */
+export function isAwake(localMinute: number, { wakeHour, sleepHour }: AwakeWindow): boolean {
+  const wake = wakeHour * 60
+  const sleep = sleepHour * 60
+
+  if (wake === sleep) {
+    // 24 hours awake
+    return true
+  }
+
+  if (wake < sleep) {
+    return localMinute >= wake && localMinute < sleep
+  }
+
+  // Overnight window: e.g. wake at 22 (1320), sleep at 6 (360)
+  return localMinute >= wake || localMinute < sleep
+}
+
+/**
+ * Converts a list of hours (0–23) to inclusive start -> exclusive end ranges.
+ * Merges across midnight if contiguous.
+ */
+export function hoursToRanges(hours: number[]): HourRange[] {
+  if (hours.length === 0) return []
+  const sorted = [...new Set(hours)].sort((a, b) => a - b)
+  if (sorted.length === 24) return [{ start: 0, end: 24 }]
+
+  const ranges: HourRange[] = []
+  let start = sorted[0]
+  let prev = sorted[0]
+
+  for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) {
+    const h = sorted[i]
+    if (h === prev + 1) {
+      prev = h
+      continue
+    }
+    ranges.push({ start, end: prev + 1 })
+    start = h
+    prev = h
+  }
+  ranges.push({ start, end: prev + 1 })
+
+  // Check if wraps across midnight: first starts at 0 and last ends at 24
+  if (ranges.length > 1) {
+    const first = ranges[0]
+    const last = ranges[ranges.length - 1]
+    if (first.start === 0 && last.end === 24) {
+      ranges.pop()
+      ranges.shift()
+      ranges.push({ start: last.start, end: 24 + first.end })
+    }
+  }
+
+  return ranges
+}
+
+export function formatHourRange(range: HourRange, format: TimeFormat): string {
+  if (range.start === 0 && range.end === 24) {
+    return 'All day (24h)'
+  }
+
+  const startFormatted = formatWholeHour(range.start % 24, format)
+  // Exclusive end hour:
+  // e.g. if start=9, end=12, start is 9am, end is 12pm.
+  // if start=22, end=26, start is 10pm, end is 2am.
+  const endHour = range.end % 24
+  const endFormatted = formatWholeHour(endHour, format)
+
+  return `${startFormatted} — ${endFormatted}`
+}
+
+export function computeSchedule(
+  cities: City[],
+  window: AwakeWindow,
+  mode: Mode,
+  now: Date = new Date()
+): Schedule {
+  if (cities.length === 0) {
+    return {
+      rows: [],
+      referenceOffset: 0,
+      currentReferenceHour: null,
+      meeting: { hours: [], ranges: [] },
+      perCity: new Map(),
+    }
+  }
+
+  const offsets = cities.map((c) => getUtcOffsetMinutes(c.timeZone, now))
+  const referenceOffset = offsets[0]
+
+  // Calculate awake status for every city at every reference hour (0..23)
+  const awakeMatrix: boolean[][] = cities.map((_, cityIdx) => {
+    return HOURS.map((refHour) => {
+      const localMin = localMinuteOfDay(refHour, referenceOffset, offsets[cityIdx])
+      return isAwake(localMin, window)
+    })
+  })
+
+  const referenceAwake = awakeMatrix[0]
+
+  // Meeting mode: hours where ALL cities are simultaneously awake
+  const meetingHours = HOURS.filter((refHour) =>
+    awakeMatrix.every((cityRow) => cityRow[refHour])
+  )
+  const meetingResult: OverlapResult = {
+    hours: meetingHours,
+    ranges: hoursToRanges(meetingHours),
+  }
+
+  // Base mode: each other city compared independently with reference city
+  const perCity = new Map<string, OverlapResult>()
+  for (let i = 1; i < cities.length; i++) {
+    const sharedHours = HOURS.filter(
+      (refHour) => referenceAwake[refHour] && awakeMatrix[i][refHour]
+    )
+    perCity.set(cities[i].id, {
+      hours: sharedHours,
+      ranges: hoursToRanges(sharedHours),
+    })
+  }
+
+  // In base mode, reference row highlights hours where AT LEAST ONE other city overlaps
+  const referenceBaseHours = new Set<number>()
+  for (const res of perCity.values()) {
+    for (const h of res.hours) {
+      referenceBaseHours.add(h)
+    }
+  }
+
+  const rows: CityRow[] = cities.map((city, cityIdx) => {
+    const isReference = cityIdx === 0
+    let highlightedHours: Set<number>
+
+    if (mode === 'meeting') {
+      highlightedHours = new Set(meetingHours)
+    } else {
+      if (isReference) {
+        highlightedHours = referenceBaseHours
+      } else {
+        highlightedHours = new Set(perCity.get(city.id)?.hours ?? [])
+      }
+    }
+
+    const cells: HourCell[] = HOURS.map((refHour) => {
+      const awake = awakeMatrix[cityIdx][refHour]
+      const qualifies = highlightedHours.has(refHour)
+
+      let state: CellState
+      if (!awake) {
+        state = 'sleeping'
+      } else if (qualifies) {
+        state = 'overlap'
+      } else {
+        state = 'awake'
+      }
+
+      return {
+        referenceHour: refHour,
+        localMinute: localMinuteOfDay(refHour, referenceOffset, offsets[cityIdx]),
+        state,
+        isAwake: awake,
+      }
+    })
+
+    return {
+      city,
+      offsetMinutes: offsets[cityIdx],
+      isReference,
+      cells,
+    }
+  })
+
+  return {
+    rows,
+    referenceOffset,
+    currentReferenceHour: currentHourAtOffset(referenceOffset, now),
+    meeting: meetingResult,
+    perCity,
+  }
+}

+import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react'
+import { getCity, DEFAULT_CITY_IDS, type City } from '@/data/cities'
+import {
+  computeSchedule,
+  type AwakeWindow,
+  type Mode,
+  type Schedule,
+} from '@/lib/overlap'
+import type { TimeFormat } from '@/lib/timezone'
+
+const STORAGE_KEY = 'tz_overlap_state_v1'
+
+export interface AppSettings {
+  wakeHour: number
+  sleepHour: number
+  timeFormat: TimeFormat
+}
+
+interface TimezoneContextValue {
+  cityIds: string[]
+  cities: City[]
+  mode: Mode
+  settings: AppSettings
+  schedule: Schedule
+  addCity: (cityId: string) => void
+  removeCity: (cityId: string) => void
+  setReferenceCity: (cityId: string) => void
+  setMode: (mode: Mode) => void
+  updateSettings: (partial: Partial<AppSettings>) => void
+  resetToDefaults: () => void
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: AppSettings = {
+  wakeHour: 7,
+  sleepHour: 23,
+  timeFormat: '12h',
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_MODE: Mode = 'meeting'
+
+function loadInitialState(): { cityIds: string[]; mode: Mode; settings: AppSettings } {
+  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
+    return {
+      cityIds: [...DEFAULT_CITY_IDS],
+      mode: DEFAULT_MODE,
+      settings: DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+    }
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)
+    if (raw) {
+      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw)
+      const validCityIds = Array.isArray(parsed.cityIds)
+        ? parsed.cityIds.filter((id: unknown) => typeof id === 'string' && getCity(id))
+        : []
+
+      const cityIds = validCityIds.length > 0 ? validCityIds : [...DEFAULT_CITY_IDS]
+      const mode: Mode = parsed.mode === 'base' ? 'base' : 'meeting'
+      const wakeHour =
+        typeof parsed.settings?.wakeHour === 'number' &&
+        parsed.settings.wakeHour >= 0 &&
+        parsed.settings.wakeHour <= 23
+          ? parsed.settings.wakeHour
+          : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.wakeHour
+      const sleepHour =
+        typeof parsed.settings?.sleepHour === 'number' &&
+        parsed.settings.sleepHour >= 0 &&
+        parsed.settings.sleepHour <= 23
+          ? parsed.settings.sleepHour
+          : DEFAULT_SETTINGS.sleepHour
+      const timeFormat: TimeFormat =
+        parsed.settings?.timeFormat === '24h' ? '24h' : '12h'
+
+      return {
+        cityIds,
+        mode,
+        settings: { wakeHour, sleepHour, timeFormat },
+      }
+    }
+  } catch {
+    // localStorage parse failed or disabled
+  }
+
+  return {
+    cityIds: [...DEFAULT_CITY_IDS],
+    mode: DEFAULT_MODE,
+    settings: DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+  }
+}
+
+const TimezoneContext = createContext<TimezoneContextValue | null>(null)
+
+export const TimezoneProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
+  const [state, setState] = useState(loadInitialState)
+  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date())
+
+  // Update current time periodically (every 30 seconds)
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 30_000)
+    return () => clearInterval(timer)
+  }, [])
+
+  // Persist state to localStorage on changes
+  useEffect(() => {
+    try {
+      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state))
+    } catch {
+      // storage quota or incognito restriction
+    }
+  }, [state])
+
+  const addCity = useCallback((cityId: string) => {
+    setState((prev) => {
+      if (prev.cityIds.includes(cityId)) return prev
+      if (!getCity(cityId)) return prev
+      return { ...prev, cityIds: [...prev.cityIds, cityId] }
+    })
+  }, [])
+
+  const removeCity = useCallback((cityId: string) => {
+    setState((prev) => ({
+      ...prev,
+      cityIds: prev.cityIds.filter((id) => id !== cityId),
+    }))
+  }, [])
+
+  const setReferenceCity = useCallback((cityId: string) => {
+    setState((prev) => {
+      const without = prev.cityIds.filter((id) => id !== cityId)
+      if (prev.cityIds.includes(cityId)) {
+        return { ...prev, cityIds: [cityId, ...without] }
+      }
+      return prev
+    })
+  }, [])
+
+  const setMode = useCallback((mode: Mode) => {
+    setState((prev) => ({ ...prev, mode }))
+  }, [])
+
+  const updateSettings = useCallback((partial: Partial<AppSettings>) => {
+    setState((prev) => ({
+      ...prev,
+      settings: { ...prev.settings, ...partial },
+    }))
+  }, [])
+
+  const resetToDefaults = useCallback(() => {
+    setState({
+      cityIds: [...DEFAULT_CITY_IDS],
+      mode: DEFAULT_MODE,
+      settings: DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+    })
+  }, [])
+
+  const cities: City[] = useMemo(() => {
+    return state.cityIds
+      .map((id) => getCity(id))
+      .filter((c): c is City => Boolean(c))
+  }, [state.cityIds])
+
+  const awakeWindow: AwakeWindow = useMemo(
+    () => ({
+      wakeHour: state.settings.wakeHour,
+      sleepHour: state.settings.sleepHour,
+    }),
+    [state.settings.wakeHour, state.settings.sleepHour]
+  )
+
+  const schedule: Schedule = useMemo(() => {
+    return computeSchedule(cities, awakeWindow, state.mode, now)
+  }, [cities, awakeWindow, state.mode, now])
+
+  const value = useMemo(
+    () => ({
+      cityIds: state.cityIds,
+      cities,
+      mode: state.mode,
+      settings: state.settings,
+      schedule,
+      addCity,
+      removeCity,
+      setReferenceCity,
+      setMode,
+      updateSettings,
+      resetToDefaults,
+    }),
+    [
+      state.cityIds,
+      cities,
+      state.mode,
+      state.settings,
+      schedule,
+      addCity,
+      removeCity,
+      setReferenceCity,
+      setMode,
+      updateSettings,
+      resetToDefaults,
+    ]
+  )
+
+  return <TimezoneContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</TimezoneContext.Provider>
+}
+
+export function useTimezone(): TimezoneContextValue {
+  const context = useContext(TimezoneContext)
+  if (!context) {
+    throw new Error('useTimezone must be used within a TimezoneProvider')
+  }
+  return context
+}

+import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  isAwake,
+  hoursToRanges,
+  formatHourRange,
+  computeSchedule,
+} from './overlap'
+import { getCity } from '@/data/cities'
+
+describe('overlap utilities', () => {
+  it('identifies awake state for standard daytime window (7am-11pm)', () => {
+    const window = { wakeHour: 7, sleepHour: 23 }
+    // 6:59 is sleeping (419 min)
+    expect(isAwake(419, window)).toBe(false)
+    // 7:00 is awake (420 min)
+    expect(isAwake(420, window)).toBe(true)
+    // 12:00 is awake (720 min)
+    expect(isAwake(720, window)).toBe(true)
+    // 22:59 is awake (1379 min)
+    expect(isAwake(1379, window)).toBe(true)
+    // 23:00 is sleeping (1380 min)
+    expect(isAwake(1380, window)).toBe(false)
+    // 2:00 is sleeping (120 min)
+    expect(isAwake(120, window)).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('identifies awake state for overnight window (e.g. 22:00 to 06:00)', () => {
+    const window = { wakeHour: 22, sleepHour: 6 }
+    // 21:59 is sleeping (1319 min)
+    expect(isAwake(1319, window)).toBe(false)
+    // 22:00 is awake (1320 min)
+    expect(isAwake(1320, window)).toBe(true)
+    // 00:30 is awake (30 min)
+    expect(isAwake(30, window)).toBe(true)
+    // 05:59 is awake (359 min)
+    expect(isAwake(359, window)).toBe(true)
+    // 06:00 is sleeping (360 min)
+    expect(isAwake(360, window)).toBe(false)
+    // 12:00 is sleeping (720 min)
+    expect(isAwake(720, window)).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('handles 24h awake window when wake == sleep', () => {
+    const window = { wakeHour: 8, sleepHour: 8 }
+    expect(isAwake(0, window)).toBe(true)
+    expect(isAwake(480, window)).toBe(true)
+    expect(isAwake(1400, window)).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('converts hours to inclusive-exclusive ranges', () => {
+    expect(hoursToRanges([])).toEqual([])
+    expect(hoursToRanges([9, 10, 11])).toEqual([{ start: 9, end: 12 }])
+    expect(hoursToRanges([9, 10, 14, 15])).toEqual([
+      { start: 9, end: 11 },
+      { start: 14, end: 16 },
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('handles ranges wrapping midnight', () => {
+    // 22, 23, 0, 1
+    const ranges = hoursToRanges([22, 23, 0, 1])
+    expect(ranges).toEqual([{ start: 22, end: 26 }])
+    expect(formatHourRange(ranges[0], '12h')).toBe('10pm — 2am')
+  })
+
+  it('formats ranges correctly', () => {
+    expect(formatHourRange({ start: 9, end: 12 }, '12h')).toBe('9am — 12pm')
+    expect(formatHourRange({ start: 9, end: 12 }, '24h')).toBe('09:00 — 12:00')
+    expect(formatHourRange({ start: 0, end: 24 }, '12h')).toBe('All day (24h)')
+  })
+
+  it('computes schedule for default cities in Meeting and Base modes', () => {
+    const cities = ['san-francisco', 'denpasar', 'geneva']
+      .map((id) => getCity(id)!)
+      .filter(Boolean)
+
+    const window = { wakeHour: 7, sleepHour: 23 }
+    const now = new Date('2026-09-03T12:00:00Z')
+
+    // Meeting mode
+    const meetingSched = computeSchedule(cities, window, 'meeting', now)
+    expect(meetingSched.rows).toHaveLength(3)
+    expect(meetingSched.rows[0].isReference).toBe(true)
+    expect(meetingSched.rows[0].city.id).toBe('san-francisco')
+
+    // Meeting overlap should have hours
+    expect(meetingSched.meeting.hours.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
+    for (const h of meetingSched.meeting.hours) {
+      // Every city's cell at this hour must be 'overlap'
+      for (const row of meetingSched.rows) {
+        expect(row.cells[h].state).toBe('overlap')
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Base mode
+    const baseSched = computeSchedule(cities, window, 'base', now)
+    expect(baseSched.rows).toHaveLength(3)
+    expect(baseSched.perCity.size).toBe(2)
+    expect(baseSched.perCity.has('denpasar')).toBe(true)
+    expect(baseSched.perCity.has('geneva')).toBe(true)
+  })
+})

Built the timezone overlap checker web app with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.

### Architecture & Implementation Details

- **Model Identity**: Browser `<title>` and primary visible `<h1>` set strictly to `Gemini 3.8 Flash`.
- **Modes**:
  - **Meeting Mode** (default): Identifies shared hours where all selected cities are simultaneously awake.
  - **Base Mode**: One city acts as the reference base (`REF`); each other city's overlap is calculated independently against the reference.
- **City Catalog**: Predefined 34-city catalog spanning all 7 world regions with IANA zones and dynamic UTC offsets (including fractional offsets like Mumbai `UTC+5:30` and Kathmandu `UTC+5:45`).
- **Reference City**: The first city in the list is the reference (`REF` badge). Clicking any city promotes it to the top.
- **Availability Settings**: Configurable wake-up hour (default `7`), sleep hour (default `23`), 12h/24h toggle, and full support for overnight ranges (e.g. `22` to `6`).
- **24-Hour Grid & Overlap Summary**:
  - 3 visual states per cell: Sleeping (muted), Awake without overlap (neutral), and Overlap (emerald highlighted).
  - Summaries display total overlap count and inclusive start \(\rightarrow\) exclusive end time ranges (e.g. `7am — 8am`, `10pm — 11pm`), with warning messages on zero overlap.
- **Two Separate Responsive Layouts**:
  - Desktop (\(\ge 768\text{px}\)): Cities as rows, hours as 24 aligned columns.
  - Mobile (\(< 768\text{px}\)): Cities as columns, hours as vertical rows with sticky navigation.
- **Persistence & Verification**: LocalStorage persistence, single command startup on assigned port `9324` (`pnpm run dev`), with full build and test suites passing.

The background dev server process was intentionally terminated following successful runtime probe and interaction testing to ensure port `9324` is free.

All unit tests and production builds are passing with clean verification. No further actions are needed.
